Members

(module scope)

Guided dev-environment installer — yarn setup. Cross-platform (Node-only, no shell): verifies Node/Yarn/Git, initialises git submodules, installs dependencies, wires git hooks, installs the CLI toolchain (firebase-tools, Google Cloud SDK) and the media-convert toolchain (ffmpeg/ImageMagick/mozjpeg), then prints the exact next steps. Read-only checks never mutate; installs are the standard yarn + package-manager operations for the detected platform.

yarn setup full guided setup — installs everything missing yarn setup --check report only — no install/write side effects

probe

Runs a command quietly; returns its trimmed stdout or null on failure.

runStep

Runs one command inheriting stdio; resolves to its exit code.

passwordlessSudo

True when sudo can run non-interactively (cached credentials or NOPASSWD).

runSudoIfAble

Runs a sudo … manual command when the caller holds passwordless sudo; returns true when the command actually ran. Otherwise returns false so the caller can print the command for a manual root shell.

CLOUD_SDK_INSTALL

Per-package-manager install command for the Google Cloud SDK — brew ships it as a cask, winget/choco carry first-party IDs, and linux distros need the google apt repo or snap (multi-step → manual).
